Name: Item Bags for Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: passersby10086
Description:
[size=4]我的天啊，SVE的物品分类简直是个灾难。农作物产出分成Fruit和Vegitable我可以理解，但是还有一部分作物被分到了Basic里。Basic里还有包括但不限于树苗，采集品，动物产品，工匠制品以及其他乱七八糟的东西。
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]对于这部分奇奇怪怪的东西，我用我自己的逻辑进行了拆分。总之，SVE的一大堆物品被拆成了五个包。

[/size][size=4]农业包：包括种子、树苗和对应产物，由皮埃尔出售

[/size][size=4]鱼类包：放鱼的，威利出售

[/size][size=4]厨师包：放吃的，在餐厅[/size][size=4]采

集品包：放采集品，在帽子老鼠的商店，这很合理

[/size][size=4]综合包：不知道怎么分类的都在这了，也在帽子老鼠那里[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]
目前根据item bag最新测试版推出了新的自定义袋子，将原有的农业和觅食合并，其余保持不变。新版本的袋子可以根据SVE的更新自动更新。需要item bag beta版


[/size][size=4]Oh my God, SVE's catalog is a disaster. I can understand that crop output is divided into Fruit and Vegitable, but there is also a part of the crop that is divided into Basic. Basic also includes but is not limited to saplings, foragers, animal products, artisans, and other miscellaneous items.
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]For this part of the strange and strange things, I use my own logic to break down. All in all, a large collection of SVE's items was disassembled into five bags.
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]Agricultural package: includes seeds, saplings and corresponding products, sold by Pierre
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]Fish bag: for fish, sold by Willy
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]Chef's bag: Put food in the restaurant
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]Collection bag: Put the collection, in the Hat Mouse shop, this makes sense
[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=4]Comprehensive package: Do not know how to classify all here, also in the Hat Mouse
[/size][size=4]
Currently, a new custom bag has been launched based on the latest beta version of item bag, combining the original agricultural and foraging functions while keeping the rest unchanged. The new version of the bag can be automatically updated according to the updates of SVE. The beta version of item bag is needed
[/size]
